narrative: 单人镜头制造孤立感。另一个人依然可能在房间里，但他们已经不再拥有这个画面的主导权。
这是让某人在对话中显得孤身一人的方法，也是给倾听者一个私密节拍的方法。它不是一镜到底（Oner），也不是长镜头（Long Take）——那些说的是时长。
单人镜头指的是画面的“占位”：只有一个主要人物。当这段关系必须以肩膀的形式，或者共享的双人镜头的形式保持可见时，单人镜头就不是合适的工具。
过早切到单人镜头，会让每一场戏都变成乒乓球式的来回切换。在恰当的时机切到干净的单人镜头，则会让人感觉对话伙伴仿佛被抹去了。
how: 给一个人取景。要拍干净的单人镜头，就让画面边缘不出现对话伙伴（干净画面，Clean Frame）。
要拍“脏”的单人镜头，可以让另一个人的身体在边缘露出一小片（脏画面，Dirty Frame），但不要构成一个经过构图的前景肩膀。景别常常是特写或中近景，但单人镜头也可以是一个人的中景。
提示词：Clean single of [Subject], one person, no foreground shoulder, the frame belonging entirely to them.
when: 用它来制造孤立感：即使另一个人在房间里，他也已经“消失”了。如果你想要的是干净的单人镜头，就不要留下一个意外构图完整的肩膀；也不要因为只有一个演员在走动，就把一个连续的长镜头称作单人镜头。
vs: 过肩镜头把对话伙伴当作前景锚点；双人镜头则保留了两位主要人物。
特写是单人镜头常用的一个景别；一镜到底说的是一个不间断的长镜头，是完全不同的概念。
单人镜头指的是画面里只有一位“占位者”。
examples_film: 《沉默的羔羊》在访谈戏里使用干净的正面单人镜头，让玻璃和对话伙伴都能消失，脸独占整个画面。这种孤立感就是一种覆盖方式上的选择。
语法：一个人，这段关系的其余部分都留在画外。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是过肩镜头（构图完整的近处肩膀）或双人镜头。破绽是出现了第二张清晰的脸，或者一个教科书式的过肩镜头。
另一个破绽是把一镜到底称作单人镜头。解决办法：只保留一位主要人物，决定要干净还是要“脏”，不要把“占位”和“时长”这两个概念搞混。

faq.a: 单人镜头是只包含一位主要角色的画面。干净的单人镜头会把其他身体排除在外；脏的单人镜头则允许对话伙伴在边缘露出一点。它说的是覆盖上的“占位”，不是“一镜到底场景”的同义词。
过肩镜头把近处的肩膀或头部作为构图前景，同时我们看着远处的脸。单人镜头去掉了这个锚点，让画面完全属于一个人。脏的单人镜头依然是单人镜头，除非近处的身体成为了真正的视点碎片，否则它不算完整的过肩镜头。
用它来在对话中或对话之后孤立某个人。不要过早切到这里，导致这段关系从未在画面中出现过，也不要把它和一镜到底混淆。

faq.q: How do I prompt Single for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：Clean single of [Subject], one person, no foreground shoulder。如果想要“脏”的效果，就说明另一个人的身体在边缘露出一小片。让第二张脸不出现在画面里。

narrative: A single isolates. The other person can still be in the room, but they no longer author the frame.
This is how you make someone alone during a conversation, or how you give a listener a private beat. It is not a oner and not a long take; those are duration.
A single is occupancy: one principal. It is the wrong tool when the relationship must stay visible as a shoulder or as a shared two-shot.
Going to singles too early turns every scene into ping-pong. Going to a clean single at the right time can feel like the partner has been erased.
how: Frame one person. For a clean single, keep edges empty of the partner (Clean Frame).
For a dirty single, allow a sliver of the other body as edge chew (Dirty Frame) without a composed foreground shoulder. Size is often Close-Up or Medium Close-Up, but a single can be a medium of one.
Prompt: Clean single of [Subject], one person, no foreground shoulder, the frame belonging entirely to them.
when: Use it to isolate: the other person is gone even if they are in the room. Do not leave a stray composed shoulder if you meant clean, and do not call a continuous long take a single just because one actor walks.
vs: Over-the-shoulder coverage uses the partner as a foreground anchor. A Two-Shot keeps both principals.
A Close-Up is a size a single often uses. A Oner is a long unbroken take, a different word.
Single means one occupant of the shot.
examples_film: The Silence of the Lambs uses clean, frontal singles in the interviews so the glass and the partner can vanish and the face owns the rectangle. That isolation is the coverage choice.
Grammar: one person, the rest of the relationship offscreen.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Over-the-Shoulder Coverage (composed near shoulder) or a Two-Shot. The tell is a sharp second face, or a textbook OTS.
Another tell is calling a oner a single. Fix: one principal, decide clean or dirty, do not confuse occupancy with duration.

faq.a: A single is a shot containing one principal character. Clean singles keep other bodies out; dirty singles let a bit of the partner chew the edge. It is coverage occupancy, not a synonym for a one-take scene.

OTS keeps a near shoulder or head as a compositional foreground while we watch the far face. A single removes that anchor so the frame belongs to one person. A dirty single is still a single; it is not a full OTS unless the near body is the viewpoint fragment.
Use it to isolate someone during or after a conversation. Do not jump there so early that the relationship never exists in frame, and do not confuse it with a oner.

faq.q: How do I prompt Single for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write Clean single of [Subject], one person, no foreground shoulder. If you want dirty, specify a sliver of another body at the edge. Keep a second face out of the shot.
